chrysanthemum.e: 拉丁语, 源自 希腊语 chryso`s gold + <?/ flower.

churn.e: 中古英语 chirne, cherne, 古英语 ceren, cyrin; 同源于 荷兰语 karn, 丹麦语 kierne. 见 Churn, v. t.

cider.e: 法语 cidre, 古法语 sidre, 源自 拉丁语 sicera a kind of strong drink, 希腊语 shākar to be intoxicated, shēkār strong drink.

cinch.e: 西班牙语 cincha, 源自 拉丁语 cingere to gird.
s: 微风，煤屑，轻而易举的事

cinder.e: 古英语 sinder slag, dross; 同源于 冰岛语 sindr dross, 瑞典语 sinder, 德语 sinter, 荷兰语 sintel; 或许 influenced by 法语 cendre ashes, 源自 拉丁语 cinis. 参见 Sinter.

k: 线务员，线路工人，护路工

cinnabar.e: 拉丁语 cinnabaris, 希腊语 qinbār, Hind. shangarf.

cinnamon.e: 希伯来语 qinnāmōn; 参见 希腊语 cinnamomum, cinnamon. The 希伯来语 word itself seems to have been borrowed from some other language; 参见 Malay kājū mānis sweet wood.

cinque.e: 法语 cinq, 源自 拉丁语 quinque five. 见 Five.
k: 独一无二的，独特的，稀罕的

cipher.e: 古法语 cifre zero, 法语 Chiffre figure (参见 Sp.cifra, 后期拉丁语 cifra), 源自 阿拉伯语 ifrun, afrun, empty, cipher, zero, 源自 afira to be empty. 参见 Zero.

circle.e: 中古英语 cercle, 法语 cercle, 源自 拉丁语 circulus (Whence also 古英语 circul), 指小词 of circus circle, 同源于 希腊语 kri`kos, ki`rkos, circle, ring. 参见 Circus, Circum-.

circuit.e: 法语 circuit, 源自 拉丁语 circuitus, 源自 circuire or circumire to go around; circum around + ire to go.

circulate.e: 拉丁语 circulatus, 过去分词 of circulare, v. t., to surround, make round, circulari, v. i., to gather into a circle. 见 Circle.

circulator.e: 参见 拉丁语 circulator a peddler.

circulatory.e: 拉丁语 circulatorius pert. to a mountebank: 参见 法语 circulatoire.

circumcise.e: 拉丁语 circumcisus, 过去分词 of circumcidere to cut around, to circumcise; circum + caedere to cut; 同源于 英语 cæsura, homicide, concise, and 可能 to shed, v. t.

circumscribe.e: 拉丁语 circumscribere, -scriptum; circum + scribere to write, draw. 见 Soribe.

circumscription.e: 拉丁语 circumscriptio. 见 Circumscribe.

circumspect.e: 拉丁语 circumspectus, 过去分词 of circumspicere to look about one's self, to observe; circum + spicere, specere, to look. 见 Spy.

circumstance.e: 拉丁语 circumstantia, 源自 circumstans, -antis, 现在分词 of circumstare to stand around; circum + stare to stand. 见 Stand.

s: 特殊的，明确的，具有特效的

circumvent.e: 拉丁语 circumventis, 过去分词 of circumvenire, to come around, encompass, deceive; circum + venire to come, 同源于 英语 come.

cirque.e: 法语, 源自 拉丁语 circus.

clavicle.e: 法语 clavicule, 源自 拉丁语 clavicula a little key, tendril, 指小词 of clavis key, 同源于 claudere to shut. 见 Close, and 参见 Clef.

claymore.e: Gael. claidheamhmor a broadsword; Gael. claidheamh sword + mor great, large. 参见 Glaymore.

cleanse.e: 古英语 clnsian, 源自 clne clean. 见 Clean.

clem.e: 参见 clam to clog, or 德语 klemmen to pinch, 冰岛语 klömbra, 英语 clamp.

clematis.e: 新拉丁语, 源自 希腊语 klhmati`s brushwood, also (from its long, lithe branches) clematis. 源自 klh^ma twig, shoot, 源自 kla^n to break off.

coffee.e: Turk. qahveh, 阿拉伯语 qahuah wine, coffee, a decoction of berries. 参见 Café.

coffer.e: 古法语 cofre, 法语 coffre, 拉丁语 cophinus basket, 源自 希腊语 Coffin, n.

coffin.e: 中古英语, a basket, receptacle, 古法语 cofin, 源自 拉丁语 cophinus. 见 Coffer, n.
k: 堂兄弟姊妹，表兄弟姊妹

cog.e: 参见 威尔士语 coegio to make void, to beceive, from coeg empty, vain, foolish. 参见 Coax, v. t.

k: 使人首肯的，使人信服的，中肯切题

cogent.e: 拉丁语 cogens, 现在分词 of cogere to drive together, to force; co- + agere to drive. 见 Agent, a., and 参见 Coact to force, Coagulate, p. a.

cogitate.e: 拉丁语 cogitatus, 过去分词 of cogitare to reflect upon, 可能 源自 co- + the root of aio I say; hence, prop., to discuss with one's self. 参见 Adage.

cognate.e: 拉丁语 cognatus; co- + gnatus, natus, 过去分词 of nasci, anciently gnasci, to be born. 见 Nation, and 参见 Connate.
s: 有亲属关系的，性质类似的，同类的

cognition.e: 拉丁语 cognitio, 源自 cognoscere, cognitum, to become acquainted with, to know; co- + noscere, gnoscere, to get a knowledge of. 见 Know, v. t.

r: tending to, connected with, or performing

cognizance.e: 古法语 conissance, conoissance, 法语 connaissance, 后期拉丁语 cognoscentia, 源自 拉丁语 cognoscere to know. 见 Cognition, and 参见 Cognoscence, Connoisseur.
s: 视野范围，知识范围，见地

cognizant.e: 见 Cognizance, and 参见 Connusant.

cohabit.e: 拉丁语 cohabitare; co- + habitare to dwell, to have possession of (a place), freg. of habere to have. 见 Habit, n. & v.

cohere.e: 拉丁语 cohaerere, cohaesum; co- + haerere to stick, adhere. 见 Aghast, a.
